findings.evidence: OrbitRelQuotient.lean has only orbitRelQuotientLift and its _mk/_comp_mk variants (lines 769-798) and no card bound of this kind; each of the four proofs repeats the Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective (orbitRelQuotientLift f …) construction.
findings.fix: Add one lemma to TauCeti/Algebra/GroupAction/OrbitRelQuotient.lean: if f is constant along each generator in S and surjective, then Nat.card β ≤ Nat.card (orbitRel.Quotient (closure S) α). Use it in all four places.
findings.issue: The same counting step (build a function constant on generator orbits, lift it with orbitRelQuotientLift and apply_eq_of_mem_closure, prove surjectivity, apply Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective) is written out four times: here, at SwapFactors.lean:700 (card_orbitRelQuotient_closure_insert_swap_of_mem_orbit), at VertexResolution.lean:655 (hcomp, via Quotient.lift and apply_eq_of_mem_monodromyGroup), and at VertexResolution.lean:689 (card_monodromyOrbit_add_orbitCount_le).

findings.evidence: Both proofs define hK : (K : Set _) ⊆ closure (insert swap K) by the same fun g hg ↦ subset_closure (mem_insert_of_mem …) and then case-split on the two generators.
findings.fix: Factor the inclusion into one lemma, or shorten both to Subgroup.closure_le plus simp/mul_mem.
findings.issue: The hle step (the original pair lies in the closure of the transposition together with K) repeats the hK/hs scaffolding of the hle step at SwapFactors.lean:768.

findings.fix: Move the normalisation into a simp only set, or a lemma giving the Euler count of Perm.sumCongr R.crossingRotation S, and use it from both places.
findings.issue: The final rw … at h₃ in IsPlanar.resolveCrossing chains about 17 named lemmas before omega; the rw at line 676 in orbitCount_add_orbitCount_add_orbitCount_mul_slot_eq is a similar 11-step chain.

summary: The proofs are compact, but one counting step (an orbit-invariant function lifted to a surjection, giving a card bound) is re-derived by hand four times instead of being a lemma, and three long named-lemma rewrite chains will break on Mathlib renames.
